cv_sections.summary:
• 3+ years of experience as a Java Full Stack Developer and
specialized in building enterprise-grade full stack applications
using Java (8/11), Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and modern
JavaScript frameworks, supporting scalable systems with consistent
performance in production environments.
• Experienced in developing responsive and user-focused interfaces
with React, Next.js, Redux, Angular, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and
Tailwind CSS, contributing to improved usability and reduced page
load times by 25%.
• Proficient in backend development and debugging with Spring
MVC, Hibernate/JPA, Node.js, Express.js, in event-driven
architectures, enabling reliable service, and handling high-volume
API validations and traffic exceeding 1M requests per month.
• Adept at designing and consuming RESTful Web Services and
GraphQL APIs with clear JSON contracts and Swagger/OpenAPI
documentation, ensuring seamless integration across distributed
microservices.
• Skilled in relational and NoSQL database technologies including
PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis, applying SQL optimization and
indexing strategies to improve query performance by 20–35%.
• Hands-on with cloud-native deployments across AWS (EC2, S3,
RDS, IAM, API Gateway, Lambda) and Google Cloud Platform,
supporting secure, scalable, and highly available application
architectures.
• Experienced in containerization and DevOps practices using
Docker, Kubernetes and CI with Jenkins pipelines, improving
integration and deployment reliability and reducing release cycles by
approximately 20%.
• Strong in version control and team collaboration using Git, GitHub,
Bitbucket, Jira, and Agile/Scrum methodologies, contributing to sprint
planning, code reviews, and cross-team delivery.
  Page 1 of 4
   
• Knowledgeable in automated testing and quality assurance
practices with JUnit, Mockito, Postman, Selenium, integration testing,
and TDD, maintaining stable releases with 85%+ test coverage on
critical modules.
